en: Fixed every turn failing with HTTP 400 on third-party Anthropic-compatible endpoints (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) since 2.1.265: a regex in the Artifact tool's input schema that those endpoints reject
zh: 修复自 2.1.265 起在第三方 Anthropic 兼容端点（`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`）上每轮都因 HTTP 400 失败的问题：原因是 Artifact 工具输入 schema 中的正则表达式被这些端点拒绝
